in_hebrew.name: דורינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דורינה הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו מתנה של אלוהים. השם דורוס נגזר מהמילה היוונית דωρος (doros), שפירושה מתנה. השם דורינה הוא גרסה נשית של השם דורוס, ומשמעותו אוצר רוחני או מתנה מאלוהים. השם דורינה משמש כמחווה לאלוהים ולמתנותיו הרוחניות.

in_greek.name: Δωρίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δωρίνα προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Δωρός (Doros), που σημαίνει δωρο. Το Δωρός ήταν ένα κοινό όνομα στην αρχαία Ελλάδα, και το Δωρίνα είναι η θηλυκή μορφή του ονόματος. Στον χριστιανισμό, το όνομα Δωρίνα συμβολίζει το πνευματικό δωρο του Θεού και την πνευματική πλούτο.

in_latin.name: Dorina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dorina originem habet in Graeco nomine Δωρός (Doros), quod donum significat. In ecclesia christiana, nomen Dorina est forma feminina nominis Doros, et significat donum Dei, gazum spirituale. Nomen Dorina est testimonium donorum spiritualium Dei et divitiae spiritualis.

in_english.name: Dorina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dorina originates from the Greek name Δωρός (Doros), meaning gift. In Christianity, Dorina is the feminine form of Doros, signifying a gift from God or spiritual treasure. The name Dorina represents the spiritual gifts and riches that come from God. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing the divine gift of faith and spiritual wealth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dorina carries a sense of gratefulness and appreciation, embodying the idea that every human being is a gift from God, a precious blessing bestowed upon the world. Cultures that have given names such as Dorina to their children place high value on the uniqueness and worth of each individual.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, Dorina is a reminder of the divine wisdom and love that pervades every aspect of creation, as illustrated in the biblical verse, "And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he was in the wilderness till the day of his manifestation to Israel" (Luke 1:80). The name invites us to recognize and cultivate the inner gift of the spirit that resides within us all.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dorina of Tarsus was a Christian martyr and virgin who lived in the 4th century. The name Dorina carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Dorina continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Dorina, a minister in New York, United States, shares that their name Dorina meaning "Gifted one" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Dorina, meaning "gift from God," embodies the grace and blessings bestowed upon us by the divine providence. It encourages us to cherish and honor the gifts we receive, recognizing that they come directly from the hands of the Almighty.
